items.note: judged partly by the Opus review after its second try: Knife lying against a body fires once: not met. On a box it fired once (tick 9080, nothing through 9654), and once more while riding a box on ice (one Lash at 10532). I checked this against the real data. `Player.prefab` carries two `CapsuleCollider`s with `m_IsTrigger: 0` on one rigidbody. `ThrownItem.OnCollisionExit` (line 155) calls `Separated(collision.rigidbody)` for each collider pair, and `Separated` (AttackRun.cs:56–62) drops the body unless the exit falls on the hit's own tick. So a knife resting across both capsules that slips off one of them clears the body while it still touches the other, and fires again. No test or play run covers a player body.
